headline: Binance Suffers $6.3 Billion Cyberattack as Bitcoin Drops Below $77,000
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance lost $6.3 billion in a cyberattack, marking the largest crypto theft in history. The incident contributed to a decline in Bitcoin below $77,000 amid broader market drops.
why: Major cybersecurity breaches on dominant cryptocurrency exchanges can trigger systemic panic, heightening regulatory scrutiny and depressing digital asset valuations across the broader crypto market.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange security breaches reduce investor confidence, driving sell-offs in cryptocurrencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The unprecedented cyber theft of $6.3 billion from Binance sparked immediate risk-off sentiment and liquidations across digital asset markets, pushing Bitcoin below the $77,000 threshold.
